nodes.name: Insert workflow_failures
nodes.notes: Configure Supabase credential (service_role). Set SUPABASE_URL env. continueOnFail avoids recursive error loop if INSERT fails.

nodes.name: Telegram Admin Alert
nodes.notes: Set TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_ID + Telegram credential. Alerts on ALL errors (not critical-only).

meta.description: Central error workflow. Logs workflow_failures + Telegram alert. NO errorWorkflow on this workflow itself. Anti-recursion guard stops loops. Assign as Error Workflow in Laila V5, Follow-up Cron, Admin Commands, Pricing.
